name: Hierarchical Sampling for Hemispherical Wavefronts
definition: A coarse-to-fine sampling scheme for 2D hemispherical wavefronts to balance reconstruction quality and computational overhead.
summary: Hierarchical Sampling for Hemispherical Wavefronts is a coarse-to-fine, differentiable method for Non-Line-of-Sight imaging that balances quality and overhead by sampling 2D hemispheres, unlike 1D ray sampling.
